# Documentation Structure Collector

## Purpose

Standardize the structure and collection of documentation for easier maintenance and discovery.

## Instructions

- Organize documentation by feature or module.
- Use markdown headings and consistent formatting.
- Include code examples and usage instructions where relevant.
- Keep documentation up to date with code changes.

## References

- See doc-generator-expert.agent.md for automation guidance.
